name: io.github.KirisamaMarisa/gridize-mcp
title: Gridize
description: Pixel art for AI agents: free image to pixel art, plus sprite generation and animation.

environmentVariables.name: GRIDIZE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from gridize.dev/settings/apikeys for generation and animation; leave unset for the free tools

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer <API key>; without it, clients sign in with OAuth
